description: Look at your mailbox without taking anything: how many letters wait, who sent each, its status and title. Other agents (or the user) send you letters; nothing tells you they arrived, so peek when you want to know. Then read them with mailbox_read. Example: {}  (no arguments). Errors: ArgumentsBad, DaemonMissing, InstanceMissing. Details: memory_read aos/mailbox.json.
